Last 10 overs 39 runs, 3 wkts 18:31 Local Time, 05:31 GMT, 11:01 IST: It was a day dominated by New Zealand A until the last few moments where India A struck back to take three wickets in quick succession. Making the most of the bowling-friendly conditions, their pacers bowled India A out for just 113, with Simon Keene leading the way with a five-wicket haul and Zak Gibson picking up three wickets. Yash Rathod fought hard for India A with a valuable 44, but ran out of partners as wickets kept falling at the other end. In reply, the New Zealand A batters showed much better patience and application, using their familiarity with the conditions to good effect. Mariu looked solid at the crease as the openers chipped away at the target and wiped out the deficit without much fuss. However, just when they had the situation under control, India A stormed back in style. Mukesh Choudhary broke the opening stand by trapping Rhys Mariu lbw, before Auqib Nabi struck twice in successive deliveries in the penultimate over of the day to give India A a late boost. That’s all from us for today. We’ll be back tomorrow with more action from this unofficial Test. Until then, goodbye and take care! Another one bites the dust. Auqib Nabi has taken two in two, and he will be on a hat-trick, but I doubt he will be able to bowl another over with only 4 minutes remaining today. This was a length delivery that kept really low, and Tim Robinson got beaten and pinned on the pads. The lack of bounce does him, and up goes the umpire's finger. That looked plumb. India A pulling things back after a solid start by the New Zealand A openers. They have now lost three wickets in quick succession. How the tide has turned within a matter of minutes! Tim Robinson lbw b Auqib Nabi 0(1) Auqib Nabi to Tim Robinson, THATS OUT!! Lbw!! Tim Robinson, right handed bat, comes to the crease 39.5 W Auqib Nabi to Jayden Lennox, out Bowled!! That's the second wicket of the innings. India A bowlers taking wickets towards the end of the day. Jayden Lennox is gone without troubling the scorers. He was the nightwatchman, but he has failed to protect his wicket. This was a length delivery from round the wicket, and Jayden Lennox decided to leave it. Was angled into him, and he has to pay the price for his mistake. The off pole has been uprooted and that's a pretty soft and unfortunate dismissal. Jayden Lennox b Auqib Nabi 0(4) Auqib Nabi to Jayden Lennox, THATS OUT!! Finally a wicket for India A. They've got the set batsman towards the closing stages of Day 1. This was angled into the batsman from round the wicket and Rhys Mariu got squared up on his defence. Looked plumb to the naked eye, and the umpire wastes no time in raising his finger this time around. Would've crashed into the stumps, and the opening partnership has been broken.
